interface.shortDescription: CTO skills and artifacts for startups.
interface.longDescription: Day Zero CTO helps early-stage technical leaders run the operating loop from a project-level knowledge wiki in Codex Desktop, Claude Code, and Claude Desktop custom skills: onboarding, context setup, guided core context refinement through interview, draft, approval, and refresh loops, decision-log reviews driven by revisit triggers, risk-register reviews driven by severity, sources, dated next reviews, mitigation, evidence gaps, and decision logging when risk reviews produce formal choices, tech stack mapping across multiple repos, weekly reviews, CEO updates, risk reviews, a skill-first workflow with one Python `dzcto` helper command, complete quickstart/help/lfg/status command references, and a stable command shim installer, configurable install/wiki locations, local install updates with numbered progress, local dashboard serving, a dedicated setup checklist page with dashboard alert state until complete and a collapsed dashboard Setup reference section after completion, one expandable dashboard Help document with nested accordion panels for guide, command reference, AI prompts, and local commands, stale artifact checks, risk review date warnings, candidate report risk sections that roll up to the canonical Risks page, redacted issue bundles, sidecar metadata, embedded HTML provenance, generated HTML core context pages with filterable Decisions and Risks tables, generated risk and decision registries with stable IDs and focused per-item detail pages that list every source/report reference, a visible skills-version footer, short current-read summaries for Decisions and Risks, Arwen-style command-center dashboard with linked KPIs, last-updated masthead timestamps, a due-only today panel, full-width core tables, anchored risk links with target highlighting, canonical risk and decision signal triage, reports grid with Open Latest actions and previous-run summaries, sticky navigation, top search, masthead breadcrumbs, and light/dark theme, spaced-repetition learning with a mastery checklist, structured JSON-to-HTML report templates with action summaries, previous-run change summaries, and unboxed bold list sections, durable HTML reports with dated index references and stored structured JSON, company-aware command-center index context, copyable AI prompt cards with exact project/repo context and optional custom prompt steering, copyable local helper commands, cadence alerts with weekday display, and a bookmarkable local index at knowledge/wiki/index.html.
